posts.text: The real reason TSA lines are so long at airports in the US is not because of the Democrats in Congress.  senate Republicans had offered President Trump and off-ramp to fund TSA separately and immediately, but the president rejected it, saying that Republicans in Congress should “not compromise”.  Responding to  @@basedinmalibu

Elon Musk suggested that Americans should let Grok, the artificial intelligence gadget, take care of their income tax returns.  because… What could go wrong with providing your financial information and private data to Elon Musk‘s artificial intelligence?

Are ICE agents being deployed at airports? The Trump administration is deploying ICE agents at US airports nationwide to make up for the lack of TSA agents, resulting from the lack of DHS funding.  This is what border czar Tom Homan said about ICE agents ability to replace TSA agents

Pete Hegseth shared a video to promote the readiness of the U.S. armed forces in the conflict with Iran.  Unfortunately for him, the person in the video is a Sergeant Major of the United States Marine Corps that was relieved of his duties after the USMC “lost confidence in his abilities“.

A video has been circulating claiming to show speaker of the house, Mike Johnson saying that the SAVE act would reduce voter turn out by 18% That information is not true. The video shows Mike Johnson, and Louisiana governor Jeff Landry discussing the expected turnout for a Louisiana state constitutional amendment, but is being reported as evidence that Mike Johnson confirmed that the SAVE act would reduce turn out.  With @Distillsocial  #saveact #factcheck
Marco Rubio says that the European Union does not get to tell the United States what international law is or how to protect the U.S. national security.  He forgets what the U.S. is doing in Iran.

President Trump wrote a message on social media complaining about lawmakers who refused to vote for the SAVE Act.  The message contained a list of other grievances and a noticeable error that uses a word (mutilization) that has not been used since the 1800s.

US district judge Paul Friedman sided with a New York Times in a lawsuit and struck down portions of a new pentagon policy that required journalists to sign an agreement that would restrict their ability to cover news independently. Most news outlets had refused to sign the policy and lost their credentials. This decision will allow them to submit for new credentials.  #pentagon #firstamendment #petehegseth
Tell me where you stand politically without actually telling me where you stand politically

Tulsi Gabbard, the Director of national intelligence, testified at a congressional about the intelligence community’s assessment of how imminent the danger from Iran was, to justify the attack by the United States.  The White House had announced that it had made the decision to strike Iran because of an “imminent threat”, but the intelligence community’s assessment seems to confirm the opposite.  ##iranwar##tulsigabbard
